easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Changeling Hero, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Lagrella until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
